primary.title: RBI wants lenders to show their cards. What will change for borrowers?
primary.summary: The RBI wants banks and NBFCs to follow clearer rules on loan spreads, rate revisions and APRs. The changes could make borrowing easier to compare, but may also push lenders to price risk upfront.
